svg.text: Four cohorts, two modalities. Each structured forget set is a rare
scVI-style encoder-decoder with shared output parameters.
One MLP attacker on 70 model-internal features, trained on the
baseline and applied to every model; a likelihood audit vs. retrained models.
Nine post-hoc methods, two constructive approaches, a fine-tune with a
likelihood target, and DP-SGD, judged against models retrained without the forget set.
METHODS, GROUPED BY WHAT THEY DO
retain FT · GA · Fisher · SSD · SCRUB · Moon
